class.name: GameplayInterpolationBuffer
class.brief_description: Bounded, time-sorted buffer for remote movement snapshots.
class.description: GameplayInterpolationBuffer accepts out-of-order samples, orders them by server time, and linearly interpolates behind the latest time. With no sample it reports empty; with insufficient samples it holds a known state; after a long gap it deterministically reports stale_held without unbounded extrapolation.

method.name: add_sample
method.description: Inserts a finite sample by server time and evicts the oldest sample above the limit.

method.name: get_sample_count
method.description: Returns the current bounded sample count.

method.name: sample
method.description: Returns a status and, when available, a copied or interpolated state.

members.member: Time kept behind the local clock when sampling.
Gap after which the latest held state is reported stale.
